arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Kansas argues the parties accepted the formula's potential inaccuracies during negotiations.
Nebraska argues the Court should correct the formula if it contains a mistake.
The United States argues disgorgement must remain an available remedy for compact breaches.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines how courts handle errors in interstate water-sharing agreements. It sets the standard for fixing formulas that produce unanticipated allocations. The outcome affects how states manage shared water resources during scarcity.
